# ppds_service_endpoints_list

List all service endpoints and webhooks registered in the Dataverse environment. Includes Azure Service Bus (Queue, Topic, EventHub), REST endpoints, and HTTP webhooks. Used for event-driven integrations that receive Dataverse change notifications.

## Input schema

_No parameters._

## Output

Returns `Task<ServiceEndpointsListResult>`.
